name: Tekpon

sources.title: Get Listed — $249 one-time, 5-step form (category, software details, contact, promo code, payment); full refund if rejected

requirements: Software/SaaS product only — one category chosen from Tekpon's large fixed taxonomy
$249 one-time fee, paid through the 5-step form (Step 1/5 shown, ending at 'Go to Pay Complete Payment')
Required fields: category, software name, software website, unique selling proposition, short description, your name, business email, company name, company position; country optional
Tekpon reserves the right to reject any application — rejection triggers a full refund
A Tekpon account (email signup or LinkedIn/Google) exists on the page for claiming software profiles
preparation: Category pick from ~130 fixed software categories
Software name, website URL, unique selling proposition, short description (max 300 words per profile spec)
Contact details: name, business email, company name, position, country
Any promotional code (there is a promo-code field)
workflow: Step through the wizard: pick your software category
Enter software details (name, URL, USP, short description)
Enter contact info; add promotional code if you have one
Tekpon builds a 'fully optimized profile' — short description, best-for, recommended company sizes, FAQs, pricing/features/integrations — and places it in the chosen category
watchFor: No free tier at all — the only route is the $249 one-time listing
The disclaimer says rejection = full refund, so the fee is at-risk only if you misrepresent the product
A promo code field exists — search for a current code before paying full price
After listing, the profile supports user reviews — encourage real users to review, since reviews differentiate rankings
The same page tries to sign visitors up for accounts — account creation is separate from the paid listing
countsAsLive: Software has a public profile page on tekpon.com in the selected category with description, FAQs and a review section
unknowns: How long between payment and the profile going live
Who writes the profile content (their editors vs. your submission text)
Whether the listing can be edited or claimed afterward without extra cost
